title: When Cow Urine Cures Constipation on YouTube: Limits of LLMs in Detecting Culture-specific Health Misinformation
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLMs to detect health misinformation that is deeply embedded in religious and spiritual traditions (Hinduism and Ayurveda). It specifically evaluates how LLMs identify traditional metaphors and religious references (e.g., 'divine' or 'amrit') and discusses the epistemic challenges LLMs face when dealing with belief systems outside of Western contexts.
